from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,os,urllib.request,time
root=Path.cwd();stage=root/'.local/step07-ci-history';base='5c3361b9cb28a49c7cbdcabf28f03c8eba470d6d';legacy='c227f8c6ecfe85895937013e4687deb40247a6ee';action='11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262';sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==base;assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
env={**os.environ,'GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM':'1','GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL':'/dev/null','GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT':'0'}
records=[]
def run(label,args,cwd,expected=0):
 s=time.time();p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,capture_output=True);log=stage/(label+'.log');raw=b'ARGV '+json.dumps(args).encode()+b'\nCWD '+str(cwd).encode()+b'\nEXIT '+str(p.returncode).encode()+b'\nSTDOUT\n'+p.stdout+b'\nSTDERR\n'+p.stderr;log.write_bytes(raw);records.append({'label':label,'args':args,'cwd':str(Path(cwd).relative_to(root)),'exitCode':p.returncode,'expectedExit':expected,'durationSeconds':round(time.time()-s,3),'log':str(log.relative_to(root)),'logSHA256':sha(raw),'logBytes':len(raw)});assert p.returncode==expected,(label,p.returncode);return p.stdout
before={n:{'sha256':sha((root/n).read_bytes()),'bytes':(root/n).stat().st_size} for n in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files'],text=True).splitlines()};(stage/'source-before.json').write_text(json.dumps({'HEAD':base,'files':before},indent=2)+'\n')
upstream=[]
for name in ['action.yml','src/input-helper.ts','src/git-source-provider.ts','src/git-command-manager.ts','src/ref-helper.ts','README.md']:
 url=f'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/actions/checkout/{action}/{name}';raw=urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=30).read();p=stage/'checkout-pinned-source'/name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(raw);upstream.append({'url':url,'path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(raw),'bytes':len(raw)})
(stage/'checkout-upstream.json').write_text(json.dumps({'pinnedAction':action,'files':upstream},indent=2)+'\n')
origin=stage/'origin.git';assert not origin.exists();run('origin-init',['git','init','--bare',str(origin)],root);run('origin-copy-own-candidate',['git','fetch','--no-tags',root.as_uri(),base+':refs/heads/candidate'],origin)
clone=stage/'default-shallow';assert not clone.exists();run('shallow-init',['git','init',str(clone)],root);run('shallow-remote',['git','remote','add','origin',origin.as_uri()],clone);run('shallow-fetch',['git','-c','protocol.version=2','fetch','--no-tags','--prune','--no-recurse-submodules','--depth=1','origin','+'+base+':refs/remotes/origin/candidate'],clone);run('shallow-checkout',['git','checkout','--force','-B','candidate','refs/remotes/origin/candidate'],clone)
assert run('shallow-status',['git','rev-parse','--is-shallow-repository'],clone).strip()==b'true';assert run('shallow-count',['git','rev-list','--count','HEAD'],clone).strip()==b'1';assert not (clone/'.git/objects/info/alternates').exists();assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=clone,text=True).strip()==base
files=[]
for name in ['store','storage','gate','domain','replay','config']:
 path='packages/persistence/src/'+name+'.ts';ref=legacy+':'+path;run('shallow-missing-'+name,['git','show',ref],clone,expected=128);raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref],cwd=root);files.append({'path':path,'legacyCommit':legacy,'sha256':sha(raw),'bytes':len(raw)})
run('legacy-is-ancestor',['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',legacy,base],root)
summary={'baseHEAD':base,'productSourceR5':'59423201ba10ee71c3d1b04cebec69659017b7c7','legacyCommit':legacy,'action':action,'defaultFetchDepth':1,'actualShallowCheckout':True,'reachableCommits':1,'objectAlternates':False,'currentWriterFilesPresent':True,'sixLegacyGitShowExits':[128]*6,'originalFailure':'Missing historical Git objects; actual git show fails, not a product/native/DB test result','noImplicitHistoryMechanism':'CI has one checkout without with.fetch-depth and no later git fetch/history step; pinned input helper defaults1, fetch depth reaches Git --depth argument; setup/install/build scripts contain no history fetch','ownership':'Private file-transport repositories only; no remote credentials/network Git fetch, services, env, DB or asset writes','legacyFiles':files,'commands':records}
(stage/'shallow-reproduction.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n');print('REAL_SHALLOW_REPRODUCED: six git show commands exit128; independent .git with no alternates')
